panels.description: DAY. Keel pump hall: rust, narrow channels, stacked housing and dust. Alex presses his palm to a vibrating pump; keep the upper machinery clear.
Alex bolts a salvaged bracket over a cracked mount as the pump steadies. Keep the upper panel clear.
A white-and-amber control node records the repair beside the pump. Keep the upper node area clear.
Alex approaches a checkpoint beneath a sign reading TODAY: DEBT TRANSFER DAY. Keep the upper sign area clear.
